v0.352 flat-unlock fixture. FIVE foreign classes unlocked at the flat 8 AP rate = 40 AP. Under the old 5-rung [0,7,21,42,70] table read with || 0, a fifth unlock indexed past the end, the whole Class unlocks line VANISHED and the character was REFUNDED the 70 AP paid for the first four; with a 2nd origin class the line went negative. This fixture is the rung that used to pay the player. It also pins that the ladder is flat: 5 x 8 = 40, not an escalating sum.

v0.354 model-(b) fixture, and the clearest statement of the bug it fixes. A level-1 Fighter awarded 79 AP takes two drawbacks worth 14 and buys one 3 AP feature. Budget 93 (79 earned + 14 granted), total 3 (positive purchases only), remaining 90. Before v0.354 the 14 was counted on BOTH sides - foldBuild put it in the budget and compute subtracted it from total again - and remaining came out 104. Four drawbacks on a 79 AP character gave 131 AP to spend against everyone elses 79. CAVEAT, added v0.355: this row asserts total=3 and that remaining is >= 0 - it does NOT assert the value 93 or 90, because this CSV has no column for either. It therefore passes whether a drawback is worth double, single or nothing at all, and it did not catch v0.354 breaking CharGen. The income side is gated by log-fuzz (compute().budget === economy().earned) and chargen-flows-e2e (a real drawback click in a real CharGen); keep this row for the build shape, not as the drawback gate.
